title: RuleDefinition
description: Deterministic rule specification generated by RuleCheck LLM pipeline or manual authoring.

id.description: Unique identifier for the rule (e.g., UUID or hierarchical slug).

name.description: Short human-readable title summarizing the requirement.

source_quote.description: Verbatim text excerpt from the BEP or EIR document from which this rule was derived.

severity.description: Severity level assigned to non-compliant elements.

is_expressible.description: True if the rule requirement is fully expressible within the rule schema. False if out of scope or too complex.

unexpressible_reason.description: Explanation provided when is_expressible is false.

unresolved_parameters.description: List of parameters mentioned in the requirement that do not exist in the active model vocabulary.

target.description: Defines which Revit elements this rule applies to.

element_kind.description: Specifies whether instance or type elements (or both) are evaluated.

where.description: Optional list of conjunction (AND) conditions filtering the target elements prior to checking.

parameter.description: Name of parameter to filter on.

value.description: Target filter value (string, number, boolean, or array for 'in').

check.description: The discrete deterministic check to evaluate against target elements.

parameter.description: Parameter under inspection (required for parameter-based checks).

values.description: Allowed discrete string values for 'allowed_values' check.
